title: Addons
empty: There are no addons here for {version}.
emptyElsewhere: Addons exist for: {versions}. Switch the version in the bar at the top.
loadError: The addons could not be loaded right now.
limit: Downloads only after login, at most {count} downloads per hour.

state.noRelease: No release yet. As soon as there is one, it shows up here.
state.unavailable: Not available right now. Please check back later.
state.noFiles: The newest release has no matching file.
state.stale: GitHub cannot be reached right now. Showing the state of {time}.

admin.orgaTip: Only admins and orga roles see and download it.
admin.tokenMissing: The GitHub token for the private repo {repo} is missing. Members see "Not available right now".
admin.tokenBanner: The GitHub token for the private addons is missing.

error.unauthorized: GitHub refuses the token: invalid or expired.
error.forbidden: The GitHub token has no access to this repo.
error.rate_limited: GitHub limit reached. It works again in a few minutes.
error.unreachable: GitHub cannot be reached right now.

install.title: Installation
install.zip: Unpack the zip into {folder}, then start the game or type /reload in game.
install.exe: Start the exe. Windows may ask the first time: "More info", then "Run anyway".

settings.sectionSub: Which addons the page "Addons" offers: repo on GitHub, release files, game versions. Private repos need the GitHub token under Connections.
settings.note: Members download through the EventHelper, never directly from GitHub.
settings.empty: No addons yet. The page "Addons" stays empty.
settings.name: Name
settings.repoSub: On GitHub as owner/name, for example mst1987/levelhelper. The page always shows the newest release.
settings.descriptionPlaceholder: One sentence on what the addon is for.
settings.assetsSub: Which files of the release are offered, separated by commas. * stands for any characters, for example LevelHelper-*.zip. Empty = every file.
settings.iconSub: Name of a WoW icon (for example inv_gizmo_01) or the address of an icon on wow.zamimg.com.
settings.installSub: Shown below the standard steps (unpack the zip, start the exe). Leave empty when those are enough.
settings.privateSub: Needs the GitHub token. Without it members see "Not available right now".
settings.orgaOnlySub: Only admins and orga roles see and download it.
settings.enabledSub: Switched off, the addon stays in the list; the page and /addons do not show it.
settings.deleteText: The page "Addons" no longer offers it. The repo on GitHub stays as it is.
settings.tokenHint: Private addons need the GitHub token.
settings.restoreTip: Resets the list to the three own addons: LevelHelper, ProfessionKit and EventHelper Sync.
settings.restoreText: The list is replaced by the three own addons (LevelHelper, ProfessionKit, EventHelper Sync). Own entries and changes are lost. The GitHub token stays.

center.title: Download centre in Discord
center.note: One message in the channel: every addon with a download button and a patch notes link. The bot does not announce new versions in the channel; the message only marks them as "NEW".
center.channelSub: The message with every addon and its download button lives there. The channel's category decides the game version (unless one is picked under "Game version"): only its addons are in the centre.
center.versionSub: Which addons the centre shows. Automatic takes the game version of the channel's category.
center.pickChannel: Pick a channel first, then post.
center.offline: The bot is not connected to Discord right now.
center.removeText: The message in the channel is deleted. Older update announcements still in the channel stay.
center.loadError: The settings of the download centre could not be loaded.
